_policy: Every guard in bin/tests/ is either run by bin/run_bin_tests.py or named here with a reason, an owner, and the thing tracking the debt. There is no third state. Exclusions may only shrink: a guard that starts passing fails bin/tests/test_bin_tests_manifest.py and must be removed here in the same PR that fixes it. Ruled in architect record fb11ad19 (Decision 4).
_why_this_exists: At origin/main 46cb20e9, 38 of 76 guards were referenced by no workflow and no Makefile target. The Makefile enumerated tests one per line, so a new guard was ungated by default. That gap hid a real defect for seven days: two migrations both numbered V194 (record ccc4c755).

test_migration_number_uniqueness.py.reason: FAILS on a real collision at origin/main: V194 is claimed by both V194__decommission_qbe_empty_tables.sql (#424) and V194__expression_register_producer.sql (#422). Excluded because it is red, not because it is broken. It must not be added to the guard's HISTORICAL_DUPLICATES allowlist - that would silence the finding rather than fix it.
test_migration_number_uniqueness.py.clears_when: V194 is renumbered on main, at which point this guard passes and the ratchet forces its removal here
